query_source: Written for this evaluation (2026-09-17) from passages sampled evenly across the book. style=lexical reuses the textbook's terms; style=paraphrase asks in everyday wording with low term overlap. Written by Claude, not by a domain expert.

judgment_pool.stages: union of top-10 dense, BM25, merged candidates and reranked (base/large, all candidates) at depth 30, plus stemmed text-only BM25; chunks of <=5 words graded 0; source passage forced to grade 2
